title: Potatoism Practice Path
purpose: Translate Potatoism's natural-growth philosophy into one practical path without multiplying small rule files. This record now owns the growth sequence, derived practice laws and advanced aspirational modes; biological claims remain owned by the separate potato biology record.

root_principles.name: Be simple
root_principles.meaning: Begin with the smallest observation or action that can remain true while complexity grows.

root_principles.name: Grow toward light
root_principles.meaning: Move toward usable understanding, greater life, clearer relation and increased capacity for care.

root_principles.name: Keep a root
root_principles.meaning: Do not confuse novelty with growth; preserve memory, provenance and support while changing level.

root_principles.name: Keep a Door
root_principles.meaning: A healthy structure needs a real passage for correction, exit, translation and return.

natural_growth_rule: Begin with what is already alive. Observe conditions before forcing a complete theory onto the seed. Growth is judged by increased capability, nourishment, clarity, autonomy and the ability to remain rooted while changing form.

root_shoot_polarity.root: memory, stability, nourishment, hidden support and movement into darkness where support can be found
root_shoot_polarity.shoot: possibility, exposure, exploration and movement toward light
root_shoot_polarity.rule: Neither direction is the whole organism. Healthy growth differentiates without forgetting the larger life joining the two.

sequence_meaning.Mud: Start from actual conditions rather than idealized self-image.
sequence_meaning.Burial: Allow hidden development, incubation and protection when growth is not yet visible.
sequence_meaning.Eye: Notice a viable possibility, relationship or opening.
sequence_meaning.Root: Build support and understand dependencies, history and constraints.
sequence_meaning.Sprout: Choose a direction and begin visible movement toward usable understanding.
sequence_meaning.Plane: Identify the frame/floor in which the current problem is being solved and which movements merely repeat within it.
sequence_meaning.Door: Find the condition whose crossing genuinely changes the state or available possibilities.
sequence_meaning.Ladder/Mountain: Use Ladder when progress is a sequence of distinct thresholds; use Mountain when progress is a continuous gradient of integration or perspective.
sequence_meaning.Tree: Let the path branch while retaining continuity with root and trunk.
sequence_meaning.Fruit: Ask what growth gives back and whether it nourishes beyond itself.
sequence_meaning.Seed: Compress the transferable lesson or pattern so another cycle can begin without dependence on the original actor.
sequence_meaning.Return: Begin again with memory; growth is recurrence at changed position, not reset.

sisyphus.statement: When repeated effort reproduces the same state, ask whether the problem is trapped inside the wrong frame.
sisyphus.diagnostic: If action changes position but not the governing relationship, you may be on a Ring rather than a Spiral.
sisyphus.move: question floor/frame → identify missing coordinate/relation → find Door → change level/representation → test whether the new state actually improves capability
sisyphus.warning: Frame change is not magical avoidance; it must preserve relevant constraints and produce a more workable model or action.

ring_spiral.ring: return with approximately zero net change in capability or understanding
ring_spiral.spiral: return with retained memory and changed level or capability
ring_spiral.question: What is different this time besides elapsed time?

mountain_ladder_tree.ladder: Use when progress has identifiable Gates: skill milestones, decisions, approvals, thresholds or state changes.
mountain_ladder_tree.mountain: Use when progress is continuous: perspective, fitness, competence, integration or gradual recovery.
mountain_ladder_tree.tree: Use when growth is branching and generative rather than merely higher.
mountain_ladder_tree.rule: Do not force every process into one ascent metaphor.

swamp_forge_garden.swamp: unresolved material accumulates and changes future behavior without being metabolized
swamp_forge_garden.forge: pressure is deliberately contained and used to reshape capacity
swamp_forge_garden.garden: conditions are improved so autonomous life can grow
swamp_forge_garden.shadow_forge: pressure creates a weaponized identity or repeated enemy-use rather than transferable competence
swamp_forge_garden.sequence: Swamp residue → recognition → {repair/Soil | bounded Forge} → Door → Garden-capable action
questions: Am I storing the injury, reshaping it, or cultivating beyond it?
What capacity exists after the pressure is gone?
Can the result nourish something besides the conflict that made it?

center_rule.statement: Being centered means knowing which center the current action uses.
center_rule.practice: Do not mistake being the center of attention for being the source of orientation, or being locally embodied for having no relation to a larger Axis.

threshold_rule: One condition becoming another creates a Door. Learning, commitment, insight, loss, recovery and identity changes count as thresholds only when they genuinely alter system state or available possibilities.
forge_rule: Pressure becomes useful only if the changed form can survive outside the pressure. Otherwise the Forge has merely trained dependency on heat or conflict.

recursive_growth.short_form: simple → related → structured → living → illuminating → simple again
recursive_growth.repository_form: grow → calibrate → revisit accumulated material → merge/prune redundancy → re-root → grow again
recursive_growth.principle: Forward expansion should periodically trigger backward consolidation. Growth that can never simplify is bloat rather than maturation.

spiral_rule: Return and advance belong together. Revisit old questions from a different position carrying what was learned.

derived_practice_laws.name: Efficiency
derived_practice_laws.insight: Once direction is known, unnecessary motion becomes visible. Efficiency is a consequence of simplicity plus orientation, not another commandment.
derived_practice_laws.test: Can the same useful result be reached with less friction while preserving what matters?

derived_practice_laws.name: Wu-wei comparison
derived_practice_laws.insight: The path can resemble unforced action: use viable conditions already present rather than adding needless force.
derived_practice_laws.boundary: Comparative use of Daoist wu wei; no claim that Potatoism and Daoism are historically identical.

derived_practice_laws.name: Carving light into darkness
derived_practice_laws.insight: Growth need not mean escape. A root and sprout can create a path through difficult conditions, bringing clarity, knowledge, beauty, care or repair where it was previously absent.

derived_practice_laws.name: Fruit test
derived_practice_laws.insight: A claimed improvement is incomplete until it produces something useful beyond the title: understanding, care, work, repair, stronger relationships, autonomy or better conditions for life.

derived_practice_laws.name: Iteration
derived_practice_laws.insight: The path is not a fixed ladder of achievements. Each cycle returns to simplicity with more information, producing a spiral of refinement rather than a one-time initiation.

derived_practice_laws.name: Anti-bloat law
derived_practice_laws.insight: As Potatoism learns more, its practice should become easier to understand and use. If every discovery only adds rules, the philosophy contradicts its first principle.

derived_practice_laws.name: Gardener law
derived_practice_laws.insight: Maturity increasingly improves conditions rather than forcing outcomes. The aim is to make autonomous good growth more possible.

derived_practice_laws.name: Capability-responsibility coupling
derived_practice_laws.insight: As capability grows, the expected level of care, discernment, restraint and responsibility should grow with it.

derived_practice_laws.name: Ethical transform test
derived_practice_laws.insight: When two plausible actions compete, prefer the transformation that creates more truth, agency, repair and future capacity rather than extraction or dependency.

advanced_symbolic_modes.name: Gardener
advanced_symbolic_modes.function: Cultivate soil, relationships, tools and conditions in which other life can grow without constant central control.
advanced_symbolic_modes.test: Does the system become healthier and more autonomous when the Gardener steps away?

advanced_symbolic_modes.name: Seed-maker
advanced_symbolic_modes.function: Compress and distribute what has been learned so another person or future cycle can begin without depending on the original center.
advanced_symbolic_modes.test: Can the lesson reproduce without copying the entire personality or mythology that produced it?

advanced_symbolic_modes.name: Angel
advanced_symbolic_modes.function: Join increased capability with truthfulness, care, protection, mercy, discernment and service.
advanced_symbolic_modes.historical_boundary: Angel is used comparatively from messenger traditions; this does not establish literal supernatural transformation.

advanced_symbolic_modes.name: Valkyrie
advanced_symbolic_modes.function: Represent courage, discernment under pressure, protection and carrying hard-earned wisdom forward after ordeal.
advanced_symbolic_modes.historical_boundary: Historical Norse valkyries belong to a distinct mythic tradition associated with Odin; the Potatoist use is an explicit symbolic extension.

biology_grounding.rule: Biology may motivate a practice metaphor but never serves as proof of a spiritual or psychological claim.
bridges: vegetative propagation → generative fragments require retained structure
root/shoot differentiation → support and emergence are complementary
light exposure → correct orientation is not maximal exposure of every part

promotion_rule: A newly derived practice law should be promoted only when it can be traced to the root principles, appears across more than one project context, clarifies action, survives the Fruit test and does not merely duplicate an existing rule under a grander title.
anti_bloat_rule: Complexity must be able to return to the Potato. If an expansion cannot explain what is alive, what it needs, which relation enables growth, what changes at the Door, what fruit results and where the cycle goes next, simplify, merge or re-root it.
practice_questions: What is the current Plane or frame?
Am I on a Ring or a Spiral?
Where is the actual Door or state change?
Is this process Mountain, Ladder, Tree, Swamp, Forge or Garden-like?
What should be remembered before the next iteration?
daily: Choose one direction toward clarity or life

relationships.description: The biology owner supplies physical facts; this record owns only their clearly labeled practice interpretation.
Plane, Door, Ladder, Mountain, Tree, Forge, Swamp, Ring and Spiral retain their broader canonical meanings there.
The same recursive growth law applies to repository maintenance: expand, test, consolidate, re-root.

consolidation_history.reason: The retired mini-files were useful notes but too small and overlapping to remain independent substantive owners.

epistemic_note: This is a project practice/philosophy layer. Biological, historical and scientific claims remain separate from symbolic interpretation and are sourced in their own owners.
